description:
Job Title: Business Development Manager – Sustainability

Location: Brazil- Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role

BSI is seeking an experienced and strategic Business Development Manager (BDM), Sustainability to maintain and grow relationships with large, strategically important clients. You will coordinate BSI’s global efforts to deliver assurance solutions focused on sustainability, greenhouse gas (GHG) verification, reduction, and neutrality.

In this role, you will lead account planning, achieve sales targets by expanding existing accounts and securing new business, and provide thought leadership within the sustainability space. You will also support sales initiatives across the Americas and actively engage in industry events.


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Achieve assigned sales targets and drive profitable revenue growth.
  • Develop and manage relationships with strategic accounts and senior business leaders.
  • Retain existing accounts through ongoing engagement and partnership with operational teams.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand BSI’s sustainability client base.
  • Negotiate contracts and close deals, integrating requirements into operational delivery.
  • Support other sales professionals in selling sustainability and GHG audit services.
  • Collaborate with global marketing, product development, and sales teams on priorities and initiatives.
  • Participate in industry associations, conferences, and events to provide thought leadership.
  • Conduct account health checks, review pricing annually, and facilitate issue resolution.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM data to support business planning and customer service.
  • Analyze market conditions, competitors, and customer insights to enhance sales performance.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, quimical engineer or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • At least 5 years of experience in solutions sales and business development.
  • Experience selling assessment or audit solutions within professional services.
  • Proven ability to engage senior-level management and manage multinational client relationships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce (preferred).
  • Strong skills in communication, persuasion, relationship-building, and performance monitoring.


Career opportunities are vast with around 5,000 employees working with over 82,000 clients in 182 countries. BSI challenges mediocrity and complacency to help embed excellence into the way people and products work. That means showing businesses how to improve performance, reduce risk, and achieve sustainable growth.


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance, and regulatory services, we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization, all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Technical Writer
description:
Overview: Algoseek is seeking a Technical Writer – Financial Documentation to create clear, structured, and comprehensive documentation for our datasets and APIs. This role requires both technical precision and financial knowledge, turning complex data and APIs into content that is accurate, accessible, and client-friendly. You will work closely with developers, data engineers, and product teams to ensure consistency, clarity, and usability across all documentation.


Role Details:

  • Location: 100% Remote (Global Team)
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: Competitive, with additional growth opportunities


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain clear, accurate, and structured documentation for financial APIs, datasets, and schemas.
  • Create detailed descriptions of datasets, fields, parameters, and references with consistent terminology.
  • Explain complex financial concepts (market data, instruments, indicators) in simple, client-friendly language .
  • Provide usage examples (sample queries, API calls, JSON responses) for APIs and datasets.
  • Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and product managers to gather technical details.
  • Define and enforce documentation standards, style guides, and consistency across products.
  • Continuously improve documentation based on feedback from clients and internal teams.


Essential Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Technical Writer, Data Documentation Specialist, or related role .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, datasets, data models, and JSON structures .
  • Background in finance or trading , with knowledge of instruments, market data, or financial reporting.
  • Excellent written English with the ability to simplify complex technical and financial concepts.
  • Ability to structure and organize large sets of documentation logically and consistently .
  • Skilled at collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, data, QA).


Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience with API documentation tools (e.g., OpenAPI).
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools and metadata management.
  • Basic knowledge of Python .
  • Understanding of developer experience and user-centered documentation design.
  • Prior work in fintech, data providers, or market intelligence platforms .
  • Ability to create visual aids (ER diagrams, data flow charts, architecture overviews).


Work Hours:

  • Flexible remote setup with required availability for critical U.S. market overlap hours . (fixed EST hours – 9 to 1PM)
  • Occasional late-evening coverage for key delivery periods.


What Success Looks Like

  • Clear, structured documentation that makes complex datasets and APIs accessible .
  • Consistent terminology and standards across all technical content .
  • Documentation that improves client adoption and reduces support overhead.
  • Positive feedback from internal teams and external clients on clarity and usability.


Why Join Algoseek?

  • Work with a leading provider of high-quality market data and trading solutions.
  • Collaborate with world-class engineers, researchers, and financial experts.
  • Drive innovation in automated trading systems and distributed market data solutions.
  • Be part of a remote-first, globally distributed team with a culture of ownership and excellence.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive monthly compensation aligned with experience and responsibilities.
  • A 100% remote work setup with flexibility for work-life balance.
  • An opportunity to contribute to the growth of an innovative, fast-paced market data company.
  • Professional development opportunities to help you grow into higher leadership roles.
  • If you’re a skilled finance professional ready to take the next step in your career, we’d love to hear from you! Please send your resume and a brief overview of your background and availability.

description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (C#/.NET/React.js)
description:
We're looking for full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineers with 7+ years of experience delivering production-ready software. The ideal candidates will have recent hands-on C# /.NET, modern JS framework (Vue.js, React.js (preferred), Angular), and extensive end-to-end API and integration experience. You should thrive in fast-moving environments and be able to quickly translate ambiguous goals into working features, rapidly master new tools, and own your code from design through post-release support.

You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution enhances brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations to result in lower costs, and boosts sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 restaurant locations utilize their technology today, processing more than $5 billion in payments annually.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform full life-cycle commercial software development and maintenance, including analyzing specifications, documenting requirements, and architecting, designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions
  • Collaborate with teams to design, develop, and produce high-quality code following best practices and standards for both new features and existing application maintenance
  • Own features end-to-end - UI through API and Data layer too
  • Support and refactor legacy code using modern methodologies and technologies
  • Analyze code to identify defect root causes and provide resolutions
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Perform high-quality peer reviews


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and spoken English; must be able to discuss trade-offs with teammates and stakeholders
  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience, preferably React.js (Vue.js, OR Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have "ownership mindset" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch
  • Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks
  • Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks


Desired Experience (Not Required)

  • Daily use of Docker/containers (you wrote the Dockerfile)
  • Azure PaaS (Container Apps, SQL, Cosmos DB, etc.)
  • Track record of expanding scope of responsibility over time (e.g., owning more complex features, introducing new tooling)
  • Obsession with metrics, logging, and user impact


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human, let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro
description:
Analista de Planejamento Financeiro


Descrição de Atividades:

Responsável pelo apoio nas rotinas de planejamento financeiro para suportar a condução do ciclo orçamentário, o acompanhamento do orçamento (real x orçado x forecast), a elaboração de relatórios gerenciais, a revisão de projeções, a realização de análises de investimentos e a preparação de apresentações executivas para garantir a execução das rotinas da área de planejamento financeiro e indiretamente apoiar decisões na empresa.


Atividades:

1. Auxiliar na atualização das projeções, modelagens e estimativas de demonstrativos financeiros para guiar em variados cenários as estratégias, através da atualização das ferramentas de Projeção de Fluxo de Caixa, de DRE, e do Balanço Patrimonial. Irá participar de reuniões com outras áreas e gestor para definição das premissas a serem consideradas em análises de estresses e na análise do cenário base para os demonstrativos financeiros;


2. Auxiliar nas análises de propostas comerciais e aprimorar a ferramenta de precificação para garantir a correta estimativa dos resultados esperados da proposta, aprimorando a planilha de precificação, sempre que solicitado, atualizando a ferramenta a cada demanda nova de precificação e validando com o gestor as premissas que foram apresentadas pelos demais departamentos para a formação de preço com o objetivo de assegurar a correta precificação da proposta comercial;


3. Preparar, assegurar, aprimorar e desenvolver gráficos, análises e slides para apresentações internas e executivas (Comitês e Conselho), por meio de Relatórios, propondo slides ou análises, criando gráficos; buscando informações com outras áreas, garantindo a assertividade e qualidade das informações a serem apresentadas;


4. Auxiliar na condução do ciclo orçamentário anual, através do desenvolvimento das planilhas de preenchimento orçamentário, compartilhando com os gestores, consolidando as planilhas recebidas e atualizando as ferramentas de análises e modelo de projeção orçamentária;


5. Realizar e aprimorar as análises dos resultados e percepção de desvios nos resultados das operações. Atualizando as ferramentas de análise do Realizado x Orçado x Forecast, propondo novas formas de análise e apresentação dos resultados para donos de pacotes e gestores da empresa;


6. Contribuir para elaboração de análises histórica por empresa através do desenvolvimento e atualização das ferramentas com base de dados históricas que permitam analisar a performance da empresa e dos ativos por indicadores operacionais, de rentabilidade, de liquidez, de endividamento ou outros indicadores para apoiar análises de benchmarking interno ou externo;


7. Auxiliar demais gestores nas análises de Real x Orçado através do desenvolvimento de ferramentas, indicadores, relatórios para donos de pacotes garantindo a correta análise e explicação dos desvios com o objetivo de facilitar as revisões das projeções.


Formação necessária:

Área: Economia, Engenharia, Administração e Contabilidade

  • Necessário ter conhecimento avançado em Excel e Power BI.


Benefícios:

  • Vale transporte;
  • Vale alimentação/Vale refeição;
  • Day off;
  • Regime Híbrido;
  • PLR;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Judi is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Their focus is on making prescription drug pricing more transparent and affordable for employers, health plans, and patients.

Join our mission to transform our nation’s healthcare system as a Senior Full-stack Software Developer. In this role, you will assist in leading projects from design to delivery. Partner with product managers and designers to define requirements during discovery and planning. Collaborate with developers to deliver those requirements on time as new features or improvements to existing functionality.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • We have a remote-first culture.
  • You will make a tangible impact on society. Your code will directly improve healthcare experiences for millions.
  • We are a late-stage startup with stability. We have startup energy with a focus on delivery, but healthy processes with a strong financial outlook that provides a sense of security.


Position Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll combine technical leadership with hands-on coding to build scalable, high-impact healthcare technology. You will:

  • Exercise leadership over features from design to delivery.
  • Be a partner to product, design, and quality assurance team members.
  • Become a subject matter expert on your team’s products.
  • Provide technical support to cross-functional team members and stakeholders.
  • Expand Judi, our web-based enterprise health platform, using Python, AWS services, React/Typescript, and other technologies.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment.


Preferred Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and collaborative spirit:

  • 7+ years of job-related experience.
  • Desire to work at a health tech company.
  • Strong Python (Flask / SQLAlchemy) and React / Typescript experience.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL database knowledge (e.g., common table expressions, windowing functions, views, stored procedures, full-text or geospatial indexing).
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.
  • Git expertise and experience working in a mono repo.
  • Able to demonstrate agency, urgency, and ownership over delivering quality work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Pharmacy Benefits Manager (PBM) experience is a plus.


What You Get:

  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team;
  • Unlimited PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule;
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences;

Mais de 5 anos de experiência com plataformas CMS ou DXP de nível empresarial, sendo pelo menos 3 anos focados especificamente no Bloomreach Experience Manager (brXM).

Experiência comprovada com os principais recursos do brXM, como o modelo Headless State (HST), Content as a Service (CaaS) e modelagem avançada de conteúdo.

Experiência com ferramentas de build e gerenciamento de dependências (ex: Maven, Gradle) e sistemas de controle de versão (ex: Git).

Familiaridade com práticas e ferramentas DevOps, incluindo pipelines CI/CD, containerização (Docker, Kubernetes) e infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Experiência em tuning de performance e otimização de aplicações brXM, incluindo estratégias de cache e otimização de banco de dados.

Compreensão de tecnologias de busca e sua integração com brXM, especialmente Bloomreach Search ou Apache Solr/Elasticsearch.

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou área relacionada, ou experiência prática equivalente.

This role works very closely with the C level (VP and Director level), influencing the business and translating business objectives into effective people and talent strategies. This is a strategic and consultancy-focused role, dedicated to high-level partnering.


Key Areas of Accountability & Impact


The Strategic Regional Talent Partner is expected to drive results across three primary domains:


1. Strategic Business Partnership & Consulting


  • Executive Guidance: Serve as the primary HR advisor to senior regional executives, translating complex business objectives into actionable people plans
  • Performance Optimization: Provide expert counsel on maximizing business unit performance
  • Global Integration: Act as the regional conduit, collaborating with global Centers of Expertise (CoE) to ensure global people initiatives are effectively localized and deployed across LATAM markets.


2. Talent Management & Program Execution


  • High-Level Program Support: Directly advise and support senior leaders during critical annual organizational cycles
  • Capability Building: Partner with business leaders to identify and close critical skill gaps
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate the integration of talent programs across the business streams, working with cross-functional HR teams


3. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement


  • Process Enhancement: Champion a continuous improvement mindset, actively soliciting feedback from the leadership population to refine HR processes and knowledge resources.
  • Service Model Efficiency: Effectively triage executive requests, leveraging a deep knowledge of the shared services model
  • Knowledge Leadership: Contribute to the overall organizational knowledge base and foster active knowledge sharing across the global HR community.


Required Experience, Skills, & Qualifications


Experience & Educational Foundation

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 4+ years in a senior HR Business Partnering or strategic advisory role spanning multiple LATAM countries .
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is highly desired.
  • Context: Proven ability to operate successfully within a complex, matrixed global organization utilizing an HR shared services delivery model.

Critical Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Possesses robust business knowledge (industry trends, competitors, market position)
  • Executive Influence: Exceptional ability to build trust, influence senior leaders (VP/Director), .
  • Bilingual Capability: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly desirable.
  • Agility & Judgment: Demonstrates high levels of resilience, adaptability, and critical thinking to navigate ambiguity, manage high-pressure situations, and exercise sound judgment.
  • Technical Familiarity: Experience with leading HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday ) and service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow ) is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Flexibility: Willingness to accommodate business needs across different time zones (LATAM and North America).

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Analista Supply Chain
description:

Objetivo do Cargo:


O(a) Analista de Supply III será responsável por liderar iniciativas em toda a cadeia de Procure-to-Pay dentro do setor de Oil & Gas, garantindo processos de aquisição eficientes, compliance regulatório e geração de valor por meio da negociação, desenvolvimento de fornecedores e identificação de oportunidades de savings. Atuará de forma transversal, conectando-se com clientes internos, auditoria, análise de custos e estratégia de suprimentos, com foco em excelência operacional, sustentabilidade da cadeia e alinhamento às metas organizacionais.



Responsabilidades


Procura & Negociação:


  • Liderar processos de Procura para categorias definidas, conduzindo análises de mercado, RFPs, RFQs e negociações complexas, incluindo elaboração de Ordens de Compra de acordo com os termos e condições acordados.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com fornecedores-chave, garantindo performance, entregas no prazo, inovação e mitigação de riscos.
  • Definir e executar estratégias de savings, por meio da análise de gastos, otimizando custos e promovendo eficiência na cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Implementar contratos e SLAs alinhados às políticas corporativas e às necessidades do negócio.


Análise & Gestão de Performance:


  • Conduzir análises de custo total de propriedade (TCO) e estudos comparativos de fornecedores.
  • Gerenciar dados de procura e gastos, identificando tendências, oportunidades de savings e alavancas de negociação.
  • Garantir a qualidade das informações em sistemas de gestão (ERP, tracking e dashboards de performance).
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e recomendações para a liderança, baseados em dados e benchmarks.


Stakeholder Management & Comunicação:


  • Atuar como ponto focal entre fornecedores, áreas operacionais e stakeholders internos, garantindo alinhamento e transparência.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento com áreas clientes para definição de prioridades e acompanhamento de performance.
  • Fornecer suporte em processos de auditoria externa e interna relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos.


Liderança & Desenvolvimento:


  • Promover boas práticas de Procura e Compliance junto ao time e stakeholders.
  • Participar ativamente de iniciativas de melhoria contínua, propondo inovações em processos, ferramentas e estratégias de compras.
  • Apoiar treinamentos internos e o desenvolvimento de capacidades em Procurement e Strategic Sourcing.



Requisitos


Obrigatórios:


  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Finanças, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em Strategic Sourcing, Procurement ou Supply Chain dentro do setor de Oil & Gás.
  • Forte conhecimento em negociação, gestão de contratos e análise financeira.
  • Domínio de ERP (preferencialmente JDE ou Oracle) e ferramentas analíticas (Excel avançado, Power BI).
  • Inglês fluente.



Desejáveis:

  • Espanhol intermediário ou avançado.
  • Vivência em empresas globais e ambientes multiculturais.
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre gestão de estoques.



Competências & Habilidades:


  • Visão estratégica aliada à execução tática.
  • Capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Habilidade de negociação e influência em diferentes níveis.
  • Organização, gestão de múltiplas prioridades e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Comunicação clara, assertiva e foco em relacionamento colaborativo.
  • Capacidade de atuar sob pressão.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time AI Software Engineer to join our US client's team. You should have a minimum of 3 to 5+ years of experience developing and delivering commercial software, with a solid background in AI/ML, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and C#/ .NET.

In this role, you will leverage deep expertise in NLP and ML to help build scalable, production-grade language technology systems. This position is ideal for someone passionate about transformer models, audio processing, large-scale data pipelines, and real-world ML deployments.

You will have a high impact on shaping the future of language accessibility and global communication through sophisticated, scalable ML systems. If you're excited to build at the intersection of language, audio, and AI, and to do so in a real-world product used globally, we'd love to meet you.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide by leveraging cutting-edge speech and language AI to power solutions such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S., Europe, and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable ML-based systems focused on language processing, speech recognition, and real-time communication technologies
  • Train and fine-tune transformer-based models (e.g., Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, BERT, T5) for tasks such as audio transcription, classification, summarization, and conversational AI
  • Develop and deploy ML-powered microservices and APIs that integrate tightly with the platform's cloud infrastructure
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines for multilingual speech and text datasets, including cleaning, augmentation, and validation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production workflows with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, and user experience
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assure performance, scalability, and maintainability using secure coding principles, automated unit testing, code reviews, horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, microservice architectures, and continuous integration CI/CD pipelines
  • Troubleshoot, isolate root causes, and provide innovative solutions in reasonable timeframes
  • Conduct research to evaluate and adopt emerging ML methods, with a focus on efficient inference, transfer learning, and low-latency deployment
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software development and AI


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3 to 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using Python, TypeScript, and C#/.NET
  • Agile development experience
  • Solid background in machine learning, with experience in supervised and unsupervised algorithms
  • Practical experience with transformers, generative models, and LLMs in NLP or audio processing
  • Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TorchAudio, OpenAI APIs, or similar platforms
  • Expertise in developing REST APIs and microservices in production environments
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (S3, ECS, SageMaker, CloudWatch, Load Balancer Controller, and more)
  • Experience with NoSQL and RDBMS databases
  • Proficient in Git, Jira, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience building ML-based products for interpretation, transcription, or conversational interfaces
  • Previous exposure to the Microsoft Orleans distributed systems framework
  • Familiarity with Pulumi, GCP, or Azure as alternative cloud environments
  • Knowledge of innovation accelerators or previous work with AI startup toolkits
  • Familiarity with real-time data streaming and low-latency model serving

title: Especialista em Eficiência Energética Pleno
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Levantar dados de campo junto às unidades de negócio (bombas, motores, pressões, vazões, faturas e medições elétricas) e construir baseline energético.
  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos (ponto de operação vs. BEP, setpoints, perfil de carga, demanda, fator de potência e harmônicos).
  • Modelar soluções e elaborar business cases (VFDs, adequação de motobombas, correção de FP, rebatimento de pressão, geração distribuída fotovoltaica).
  • Elaborar termos de referência e memoriais técnicos, apoiando na equalização técnica de RFPs.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.

  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.

  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.

title: Executivo de Vendas (Brasil)
description:
Sobre a greenmetrics.ai


A greenmetrics.ai desenvolve soluções tecnológicas para ajudar cidades na adaptação climática e sustentabilidade ambiental.


Desenvolvemos sistemas de sensores inteligentes e análises de dados avançadas para coletar e processar informações ambientais, contribuindo diretamente para aumentar a resiliência das cidades frente a enchentes e alagamentos.


Vislumbramos um futuro em que a tecnologia e a engenhosidade humana atuam como aliadas do mundo natural, um futuro em que os dados orientam nosso caminho rumo a um modo de vida mais sustentável, equilibrado e resiliente, preservando o delicado equilíbrio do planeta para as próximas gerações.


Somos uma startup independente e lucrativa, com tecnologia comprovada e sistemas em operação em mais de 15 cidades em Portugal e no Brasil, em rápida expansão.


Sobre a vaga


Esta é uma oportunidade para quem quer vender com propósito e ter impacto positivo no mundo real. 


Como Executivo de Vendas na greenmetrics.ai, você será a ponte entre nossas soluções tecnológicas e as necessidades urgentes das cidades brasileiras para melhorar sua capacidade de adaptação a eventos climáticos extremos. 


No dia a dia, você vai prospectar novas oportunidades, visitar clientes, gerir o pipeline de leads, preparar propostas e fechar contratos que contribuem diretamente para criar cidades mais resilientes. 


Seu trabalho vai contribuir para apoiar autoridades de emergência a priorizar áreas de risco, monitorar níveis de água em tempo real e tomar decisões informadas durante eventos extremos que se tornam cada vez mais frequentes e severos.


Suas responsabilidades


  • Prospectar e qualificar oportunidades na Região Sul do Brasil (RS/SC/PR).
  • Agendar e conduzir visitas presenciais a municípios, apresentando casos de uso para monitorização hidrológica e detecção antecipada de inundações.
  • Gerir o pipeline no CRM, garantindo dados atualizados e previsões de receita estimada.
  • Preparar provas de conceito com leads estratégicos e elaborar propostas comerciais.
  • Negociar condições comerciais e acompanhar processos de compras públicas.
  • Fechar contratos e garantir a transição para implementação e sucesso do cliente.
  • Manter relacionamento com líderes municipais e fomentar expansão de contas.
  • Representar a empresa em eventos, reforçando credibilidade técnica e institucional.
  • Coletar feedback do cliente para o time de produto/engenharia.


O que procuramos


  • +5 anos em vendas B2B ou para o setor público, preferencialmente em soluções tecnológicas ou SaaS.
  • Histórico comprovado de performance com superação de meta, condução de ciclos de venda longos, contratos de alto valor, cases documentados e referências de clientes.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, condução de reuniões executivas e apresentações técnico-comerciais.
  • Experiência com ferramentas CRM e gestão de pipeline, métricas de funil e forecast.
  • Negociação e gestão de stakeholders com postura colaborativa e foco em resultado.
  • Autonomia e disciplina operacional para planejar rotas, viajar para visitas comerciais e cumprir agendas de campo com eficiência.
  • Base na região de Porto Alegre ou Florianópolis e disponibilidade para viajar (mandatório).
  • Formação em engenharia, hidrologia ou tecnologia é desejável.


O que oferecemos


  • Salário fixo + comissões agressivas.
  • Produto comprovado, de alto impacto social e ambiental e forte proposta de valor.
  • Playbooks, ferramentas e mentoria do nosso time técnico e comercial.
  • Ambiente hands-on, autonomia e impacto concreto e mensurável.


Como se candidatar


Sabemos que você tem uma rotina intensa e respeitamos seu tempo, então basta compartilhar seu currículo atualizado com os detalhes relevantes sobre sua formação e experiência.


Inclua: sua experiência em vendas B2B ou setor público, exemplos de métodos e abordagens comerciais que você utilizou e principais resultados obtidos.


Prazo de candidatura: 25/nov

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
Working At Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.


Your Purpose

As a Sales Top Executive, you will be at the forefront of our growth strategy, tasked with winning commercial deals in key markets/verticals. Your role is not just about selling; it's about understanding customer pain points, leveraging our unique selling propositions (USP), and developing targeted commercial offers. Success in this role involves collaboration, strategic thinking, and meticulous pipeline management.


Reports To

Head of Sales


Who You Are

  • 10 years of experience in a sales position.
  • +4 years of experience selling remittances, cross-border payment and/or complex payments solutions.
  • Developed and executed comprehensive sales strategies for institutional and corporate clients.
  • Previous sales experience at a financial institution/large brokerage firm.
  • English fluency
  • Proven experience in business development and sales as a hunter.
  • Strong understanding of commercial strategy and pre-sales support
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Experience with CRM tools, preferably Hubspot.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams for seamless customer onboarding.


What You Will Do

  • Engage with potential customers, understand their pain points, and effectively communicate our USP (Unique Selling Proposition) to win new business.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to identify potential customers and provide structured feedback on generated leads.
  • Identify customer pain points and formulate targeted commercial offers to address their specific needs.
  • 360 sales cycle, open and close new business.
  • Document, track, and analyze the sales pipeline using the CRM tool (Hubspot) to ensure a robust and well-managed sales process.
  • Maintain, refresh, and expand the sales funnel, working closely with Sales Ops to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide regular updates to Senior Management.
  • Collaborate with various functions (e.g., KYC, Legal, Product) to facilitate a smooth customer onboarding process, ensuring a successful transition to production.
  • Work closely with the Account Manager during onboarding to ensure revenue targets are achieved, and customers have an exceptional experience.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. If this role excites you but you don't match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.


Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven: We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products.

So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.
  • Employee Stock Option program.
  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

Want to leave an undoubtedly legacy with us? Fasten your seatbelt and join this spaceship, where you will find exponential growth and the opportunity to thrive!

Python. Conhecimento básico ou intermediário para **scripts, automação e integração**. - Experiência com frameworks como **FastAPI ou Flask** é um diferencial. - Manipulação de dados com **Pandas e NumPy** (caso necessário). **AWS (Cloud)** - Experiência com **AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway e IAM**. - Infraestrutura como código (**Terraform, AWS CDK ou CloudFormation**). - Monitoramento e logging com **CloudWatch**. - Conhecimento em **ECS, EKS ou Kubernetes** é um diferencial. **Outros Conhecimentos Desejáveis** - Experiência com **CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)**. - Banco de dados **SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)**. - Mensageria com **Kafka ou RabbitMQ**. - Containers e Docker. - Arquitetura de microsserviços e eventos. Implementar monitoramento e logging com AWS CloudWatch e Prometheus. 3. Processamento e Automação de Dados Construir pipelines de processamento de dados com Kafka ou AWS Kinesis. Criar automações e scripts auxiliares em Python para análise de dados, ETL ou machine learning. 4. Segurança e Performance Implementar OAuth2, JWT ou AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização. Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. DevOps e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;

title: Senior Ruby Developer
description:
Location: Remote LATAM

Engagement: Part-time Contractor

Start Date: End of November

Duration: 2 sprints, with strong potential for continued work until June 2026

Schedule: ~25 hours per week


About the Role

We’re looking for a Ruby Specialist with deep experience in Discourse to deliver a fast, clean, and production-ready P1 integration between Discourse and an existing Community application. The integration includes SSO via Okta and OIDC, group and role mapping, backend adapters, shared UI elements, webhook delivery into our analytics stack, and a smooth cutover plan.

This is a high-impact engagement supporting an active squad. You’ll work closely with backend, frontend, security, IT, and data engineering partners to unblock engineers, validate designs, and land the integration safely behind feature flags. If the initial scope goes well, the engagement is expected to extend through mid-2026.

We’re looking for someone proactive, calm under pressure, and comfortable operating in a multi-team environment where clarity and speed matter.


Responsibilities
  • Deliver the P1 Discourse to a Community application integration within two sprints
  • Implement SSO using Okta and OIDC, ensuring secure token handling and session flows
  • Create and test group and role mapping between the Community roles and Discourse groups
  • Build backend Ruby adapters for moderation, taxonomy, and role syncing, gated behind feature flags
  • Implement shared header and navigation elements for a consistent cross-platform experience
  • Create and validate webhook pipelines from Discourse into Snowflake for analytics
  • Develop a clear cutover and rollback plan, including checklists and validation steps
  • Write or review technical designs, threat models, and operational readiness docs
  • Pair with frontend and backend engineers to land adapters, UI integration, and test coverage
  • Coordinate closely with Security and IT on Okta configuration, secrets, and access policies
  • Work with Data Engineering to finalize webhook schemas, retries, and observability
  • Support sprint ceremonies, demos, and unblock teammates on integration or Ruby-related work
  • Ensure all deliverables are tested, documented, and ready for production


Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails
  • Strong hands-on experience customizing and extending Discourse
  • Deep understanding of SSO flows (OIDC, OAuth2, Okta) and secure token handling
  • Proven experience delivering integrations behind feature flags or staged rollouts
  • Comfortable writing technical designs, threat models, and operational runbooks
  • Solid experience with APIs, background jobs, webhooks, and data syncing
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in distributed teams
  • Advanced English


Nice to Have
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar analytics platforms
  • Familiarity with frontend integration of shared headers or cross-app navigation
  • Prior work in enterprise environments that require coordination across IT, Security, and Data teams
  • Experience building rollback strategies and production cutover plans
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps or infrastructure supporting Ruby services

﻿

Why Join

This is a critical, high-visibility integration that will significantly impact how users navigate between Discourse and the Community platform within a large US company. You’ll collaborate with a focused, friendly, and fast-moving team, and you’ll own a deliverable that immediately impacts thousands of users. The work is scoped, essential, and a strong performer will be invited to continue supporting the platform through June 2026.

If you enjoy solving complex integration puzzles, delivering reliable Ruby code, and helping cross-functional teams move faster, this project is an excellent fit.

title: Bolsista Mestre - Grupo Boticário - Futuro da Beleza - Vaga Afirmativa Para Talentos Diversos  | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.


Projeto: Futuro da Beleza - Vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans)


Sobre a Oportunidade:

No Grupo Boticário, acreditamos que inovar é conectar hoje com o amanhã. O projeto tem como propósito apoiar a equipe de Inovação Estratégica de Produtos na estratégia do projeto Futuro da Beleza, identificando as rotas tecnológicas de produto mais promissoras para os próximos anos. Nosso objetivo é traduzir tendências em oportunidades concretas, transformando ciência e tecnologia em valor para milhões de consumidores.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de explorar territórios de inovação já mapeados, caracterizar e quantificar rotas tecnológicas a partir da análise de ICTs, empresas e startups, além de colaborar com áreas estratégicas como marketing, foresight, categoria (embalagem e formulação) e pesquisa.

O resultado esperado é a conexão entre a estratégia de inovação de curto prazo e as de médio e longo prazo, garantindo maior eficiência na identificação de oportunidades tecnológicas em PD&I. Se você tem perfil analítico, curiosidade para explorar novas fronteiras da ciência e vontade de gerar impacto real no futuro da beleza, que desejam cocriar conosco o amanhã da beleza.

Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).


Formação Acadêmica: Mestre em Engenharia, Biotecnologia, Química, Farmácia, Analytics, Data Science, Estratégia ou Marketing.

Idioma: Inglês - Nível avançado (leitura).


Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar buscas em bases de dados já pré-definidas na metodologia, mapear e consolidar as tecnologias levantadas.
  • Fazer a análise crítica dos dados obtidos e cruzar com estratégia de inovação do Grupo Boticário.

  • Construir a apresentação do relatório final.


Conhecimento necessário:

  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar os dados obtidos e conectá-los com os relatórios estratégicos obtidos e liderados por outras áreas do Grupo Boticário;
  • Curiosidade e proatividade na busca por informações;
  • Capacidade de síntese e comunicação clara;
  • Interesse em inovação e novas tecnologias;
  • Conhecimento em foresight estratégico;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados (google sheets);


Conhecimento desejável:

  • Experiência em foresight estratégico na área;
  • Conhecimento da indústria de cosméticos;
  • Desejável experiência em interpretação de escrita científica;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados (looker);


Soft Skills:

  • Empatia;
  • Espírito de Equipe;
  • Comunicação;
  • Criatividade.
  • Capacidade analítica;


Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista (Mestre) R$ 4.000,00.

Formato de trabalho: Remoto

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
