title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers.
The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.
In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.
Your Impact
  • Escalation Leadership
    • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
    • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
    • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
    • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
    • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
    • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
    • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
    • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
    • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
    • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
    • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
    • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
    • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
    • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
    • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
    • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process/system/product
    • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
    • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
    • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
    • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Fully fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish both written and verbal
  • Customer Experience
    • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and/or service delivery roles
    • Past experience as Escalations Engineer/Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
    • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program/Project management
    • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
    • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
    • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA/SLO/Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
    • Experience with Networking/Security Products
    • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, encompassing general routing/switching/security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues
Additional Information
The Team
The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.
Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making
As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. title: SAP PPDS Consultant
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced SAP PPDS Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PPDS/ePPDS) , preferably in an S/4HANA environment . This role involves working closely with business stakeholders to design, configure, and implement advanced planning solutions that optimize manufacturing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation and support of SAP PPDS solutions in S/4HANA environments.
  • Collaborate with business and IT teams to gather requirements and provide the best SAP-based planning and scheduling solutions.
  • Configure PPDS functionalities such as heuristic-based planning, optimizer-based planning, block planning, and capacity leveling.
  • Optimize master data such as resource capacities, production versions, PDS (Production Data Structures), and PPMs (Production Process Models) .
  • Integrate PPDS with other SAP modules like PP, MM, SD, and EWM for seamless production planning.
  • Provide expertise in Order-based and Time-continuous Scheduling , pegging strategies, and alert monitoring.
  • Support CIF (Core Interface) integration between SAP ERP and PPDS.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring smooth business operations.
  • Conduct user training and create documentation for system configurations and processes.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in SAP PPDS implementation and support.
  • Strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA PPDS , including DS Board, PPDS Optimizer, Planning Procedures, and Interactive Planning .
  • Experience in CIF integration between SAP ECC/S4HANA and PPDS.
  • Solid understanding of production planning processes , including Make-to-Order (MTO), Make-to-Stock (MTS), and Repetitive Manufacturing .
  • Hands-on experience in heuristics, capacity leveling, and scheduling strategies .
  • Strong knowledge of SAP PP/MM and integration with EWM .
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP PPDS certification .
  • Experience with Industry-specific solutions such as Automotive, Consumer Goods, or Manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning) and APO (Advanced Planning & Optimization).

Experience in coordinating with business stakeholders to prioritize work, plan sprints, and ensure smooth project delivery.

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software
description:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Missão:

Garantir a evolução contínua da arquitetura de TI da Dimensa, atuando de forma transversal nas BUs para padronizar tecnologias, impulsionar inovação e assegurar que os produtos atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, elasticidade, segurança, performance e time-to-market. O arquiteto será responsável por criar frameworks, acelerar a produtividade, viabilizar novos produtos voltados a Dados e IA, apoiar os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, promover a evolução tecnológica, apoiar a operação de sistemas críticos e representar a arquitetura nas frentes corporativas e junto aos clientes, alinhados à estratégia da arquitetura corporativa.


O Que Você Vai fazer (As Principais Entregas):

  • Apoiar as BUs com diretrizes arquiteturais, garantindo aderência e alinhamento estratégico
  • Atuar na construção e manutenção da nova plataforma de aceleração de sistemas
  • Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias visando à evolução tecnológica dos produtos da empresa.
  • Elaborar e gerir documentos técnicos de decisão, como ADRs, RFCs e RFPs, para formalização de propostas e mudanças arquiteturais
  • Realizar governança técnica com foco em riscos, impactos e sustentabilidade das soluções
  • Propor melhorias e novos produtos com base em oportunidades tecnológicas, dados e IA
  • Representar a Arquitetura em fóruns corporativos e alinhar iniciativas estratégicas com as Business Units (BUs)
  • Definir processos relacionados à arquitetura corporativa e governança técnica
  • Atuar diretamente em crises de produtos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções relacionadas à performance, escalabilidade ou estabilidade
  • Conduzir due diligence técnica de novas soluções, tecnologias, fornecedores e M&A
  • Conduzir estudos e provas de conceito em soluções de IA, com foco em viabilidade e valor
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e seu impacto nos produtos e na estratégia da empresa


O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Arquitetura de Software moderna (microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, Domain-Driven Design, Dados e IA).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Cloud & DevOps. Ex: AWS, Azure ou GCP; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub Actions).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tipo de banco de dados. Ex: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, além de NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), etc.
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Observabilidade & Resiliência: Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, Circuit Breakers.
  • Ter capacidade de avaliar Segurança. Ex: OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, gestão de secrets, compliance (LGPD/PCI-DSS).
  • Ter capacidade de utilizar as Metodologias: SCRUM/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, SRE, FinOps básico.
  • Ferramentas de documentação: ADR tools, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


Learn more here:

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

description:

Experiência em desenvolvimento de software e arquitetura de sistemas.

Conhecimento de tecnologias de integração: Familiaridade com ferramentas e tecnologias de integração, como plataformas de integração de aplicativos (APIs), plataformas de integração de eventos (ESBs) como Kafka e RabbitMQ e de ferramentas de ETL.

Adaptação à mudanças;

Habilidade para reconhecer problemas e propor soluções;

Entendimento e capacidade de ajustar às prioridades e direcionamentos;

Capacidade de assumir responsabilidades;

Trabalho em equipe:

Proatividade;

Comprometimento com as entregas;

Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica;

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Software Engineer
description:
About the Company : DXC Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration. We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance. Whether you possess a background in finance, technology, or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.



About the Role : This role involves advising on Murex best practices, contributing to client-site implementations, providing client support, and communicating development needs to the Murex product development team.



Responsibilities :



  • Junior:
  • Advising on Murex best practices in the P&L processes, position management, accounting, hedge accounting and financial reporting.
  • Contributing to client-site MX.3 implementations during the requirements gathering, design, build, test, and deployment phases by participating in workshops, preparing documentation, configuring client requirements and performing quality assurance tests.
  • Providing client support including managing open issues and supporting upgrade activities.
  • Communicating development needs to the Murex product development team.
  • Providing internal and external training.


  • Senior:
  • Advising on Best Practices: Provide guidance on Murex best practices in P&L processes, accounting, hedge accounting, position management, and financial reporting.
  • Client-Site Implementations: Lead all trading designers during an implementation or upgrade; gathering, design, build, test, and deployment phases by participating in workshops, preparing documentation, configuring client requirements, and performing quality assurance tests.
  • Client Support: Manage open issues and support upgrade activities.
  • Communication: Handle the relationship with the product team in one area of expertise and assist in building the product roadmap for the region.
  • Documentation and Training: Provide internal and external documentation and training.




Qualifications :



  • Junior: Ideal candidate is someone with 2-3 years' experience in capital markets technology. The candidate should have a good understanding of accounting principles under IFRS or US GAAP. Knowledge of hedge accounting is a plus. Preferable experience includes supporting either trading, treasury or accounting at banks or other financial institutions or has experience with other fintech vendors. Strong academic background in accounting, engineering or a math-based discipline (math, operations research, statistics etc.). Knowledge of Unix/Linux operating system, SQL, and basic programming is a plus.


  • Senior: The ideal candidate has more than 5 years of experience in capital markets technology. Proven client-facing experience in a support or project implementation role, preferably in trading or risk management solutions in financial institutions. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a master's in financial engineering, Applied Finance/Statistics/Mathematics, or Computational Finance. Systematic problem solver with critical thinking abilities. Strong presenter and effective communicator. Knowledge of Unix/Linux operating systems, SQL, and basic programming.



Required Skills :



  • Good product knowledge/understanding in IRD, CRD, COM, EQD, FXD, FXMM.
  • Good understanding of accounting principles, accounting rules, ledger, and account balances.
  • Good working knowledge of Murex Accounting knowledge.
  • Strong understanding of Back Office functions as well as processing.
  • Strong functional and technical understanding on the settlement instructions.
  • Good knowledge of the different post-trade interactions between the various actors of capital markets including service providers.
  • Good understanding of OSP (open settlement protocol).



Preferred Skills :



  • BS or higher degree in Finance, Mathematics or equivalent.
  • Implementations and upgrades.
  • Test management.
  • Trade life cycle management.
  • Market Data management.
  • Knowledge in SQL (Oracle and/or Sybase) and Unix commands is a plus.
  • Good understanding of Market Risk Management (including VaR, stress-tests, back-testing).
  • Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.
  • Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.
  • Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.
  • Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.
  • Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.
  • Analytical decision-making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.


Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!


Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.


We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).



Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Salesforce Developer / Integration Specialist (Specright & Interius)
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Developer / Integration Specialist to support and enhance integrations between Specright PDMS (Salesforce-based) and Interius (Azure-hosted) systems. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Salesforce integrations, API development, and Azure environments. This role focuses primarily on integration development and enhancement , not just application support.

Key Responsibilities

Integration & Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Specright , Interius , and other enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with middleware and infrastructure teams to build and test API connections , handling authentication, performance, and error scenarios.
  • Develop and troubleshoot Salesforce Dataloader scripts and data automation tools.
  • Create and maintain data flow diagrams, mappings, and technical documentation for integrations.
  • Troubleshoot integration and data synchronization issues across Salesforce and Azure environments.

Platform Configuration

  • Configure Specright workflows, templates, and user roles based on business needs.
  • Optimize platform performance and usability.
  • Support supplier onboarding , including portal access and user training.

Application & Technical Support

  • Provide Tier 2/3 support for integration and platform-related incidents.
  • Collaborate with platform vendors and internal IT teams to resolve escalated technical issues.
  • Monitor integration health and performance, identifying improvement opportunities.

Business Analysis & Collaboration

  • Partner with business users to gather and validate integration requirements .
  • Document use cases, functional and technical specifications.
  • Participate in workshops with cross-functional teams (Packaging, Procurement, Quality, Supply Chain).
  • Support knowledge transfer and internal team training for long-term solution sustainability.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of Specright PDMS and Salesforce architecture.
  • Proven experience with API development and integrations (REST/SOAP, JSON, XML).
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure tools (Logic Apps, API Management, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Dataloader and Specright Data Loader .
  • Knowledge of authentication mechanisms such as OAuth, SSO, and token-based access.
  • Expertise in data mapping and transformation across enterprise systems.

Functional Skills

  • Strong business analysis and documentation capability.
  • Understanding of packaging data management or supplier collaboration processes .
  • Experience in regulated environments with compliance or audit requirements.
  • Excellent communication and ability to work independently in remote, cross-functional settings.

Experience Requirements

  • 5+ years in enterprise SaaS or Salesforce integration projects.
  • 2+ full implementations involving Specright or comparable Salesforce-based data systems.
  • Demonstrated success in integration and API-based development using Salesforce and Azure.

title: Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil-based)
description:
About the Role

Mindhive builds AI-powered vision systems that transform industrial production. As we scale globally, reliability, observability, and rapid issue response are critical. The Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil) plays a central role in ensuring our systems remain healthy across LATAM and European time zones.

You will lead the Platform Operations function — the customer-adjacent, reliability-focused counterpart to our Platform Engineering team in New Zealand. Your team will ensure our deployed systems are monitored, stable, recoverable, and well-understood by the rest of the business.

This role focuses on:

  • monitoring, alert quality, and fast incident response
  • supporting on-premise and edge deployments
  • improving operational processes and tooling
  • follow-the-sun coverage across Brazil and Portugal
  • ensuring operational readiness for engineering-led upgrades

You will collaborate closely with the NZ-based Platform Engineering team, who drive deep engineering projects (Puppet 8 rollout, Python 3.13 upgrade, CDK migration, CI/CD consistency, platform hardening, test-rig reliability). Together, you will form Mindhive’s global reliability backbone.

This is a hands-on leadership role with high impact on customer experience, system uptime, and our ability to scale installations worldwide.


About You

You are a strong operational leader with deep hands-on technical skills. You thrive in live production environments, enjoy solving real-world system issues, and understand how to build reliable systems across time zones. You excel in:

  • structured incident response
  • observability and monitoring
  • improving operational processes
  • leading teams in distributed, multicultural environments
  • working close to customers to ensure uptime and stability

You care about technical quality, clarity, and people — and you bring a mindset focused on resilience, collaboration, and steady improvement.


Key Competencies

  • Operational Excellence - builds systems, processes, and behaviours that improve stability and reliability.
  • Leadership & Mentorship - develops engineers and coordinates distributed teams.
  • Systems Thinking - sees the interplay between cloud, edge hardware, software, people, and processes.
  • Collaboration - works closely and constructively with NZ Platform Engineering and cross-functional teams.
  • Calm Under Pressure - handles incidents and live issues with clarity and good judgement.
  • Continuous Improvement - always looking for ways to automate, simplify, and strengthen operations.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations Leadership

  • Lead and grow the Platform Operations team across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Build a high-performing follow-the-sun operational capability that supports both internal teams and customers.
  • Establish clear daily operational rhythms, including alert review, ticket management, and incident response.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Mentor engineers and technicians across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure communication is clear, predictable, and aligned with our values.
  • Build a team that is highly accountable, collaborative, and customer-focused.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Own the quality and accuracy of Datadog dashboards, alerts, service catalog, resource catalog, and operational visibility.
  • Reduce alert noise, improve signal quality, and ensure teams receive actionable information.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.

Incident Response & Reliability

  • Oversee first-line and second-line incident response during LATAM and EU hours.
  • Ensure fast, structured triage for issues across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments.
  • Maintain clear escalation paths and strong communication practices during incidents.
  • Partner with Implementation and Customer Success teams to resolve client-facing issues.

Collaboration with Platform Engineering (NZ)

  • Act as the operational counterpart to NZ Platform Engineering.
  • Ensure operational readiness for major engineering initiatives, such as:

-Puppet 8 migration

-Python 3.13 upgrade

-CDK migration

-CI/CD unification

-Platform hardening

-Test rig and E2E reliability improvements

  • Provide field feedback, operational insights, and rollout support for these improvements.

System Health & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor the health of live systems across sites and proactively identify stability risks.
  • Help drive improvements in:

-edge hardware reliability

-network stability

-server provisioning consistency

-observability for both cloud and on-prem components

  • Work with teams to reduce operational toil and automate repetitive tasks.


Required Skills & Experience

Leadership & Communication

  • Experience leading distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Excellent communication in English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, implementation, and customer-facing teams.
  • Strong organisational skills with ability to manage competing priorities.

Technical

  • Strong background in DevOps, SRE, or Production Engineering environments.
  • Hands-on experience operating hybrid cloud + on-premise / edge systems.
  • Proficiency with:

-Datadog (or similar observability platforms)

-AWS (IAM, networking, security, monitoring)

-Containerization (Docker)

-Kubernetes / K3S

-IaC tools (AWS CDK ideal)

  • Solid programming skills in Python (TypeScript/JavaScript is a plus).
  • Understanding of security best practices (identity, access, endpoint, and network security).

Operational

  • Experience running incident response, on-call processes, or follow-the-sun operations.
  • Proven ability to write and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.
  • Experience supporting industrial, IoT, or hardware-integrated systems (ideal).


About Us

Mindhive Ltd is a fast-moving AI company using machine learning and computer vision to reimagine industrial systems. Our products run across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments, bringing AI performance and reliability directly to the factory floor.

We care deeply about people, quality, and impact. We work collaboratively, iterate quickly, and tackle meaningful, complex problems.

Mindhive is a New Zealand Hi-Tech Awards winner, recognised for innovation and impact in software, AI, and advanced manufacturing.


Work Environment & Flexibility

We support hybrid and remote work, with our people distributed across Brazil, Portugal, Italy, Japan and New Zealand. We trust each other to deliver results in ways that suit our lives while maximising our collective impact. We move quickly, adapt fast, and support each other through the ups and downs that come with building something new and meaningful.


Our values

  • Relentless Curiosity - we explore deeply, question assumptions, and seek better ways.
  • Authentic Humanity - we support and care for people first.
  • Inclusive Connection - we collaborate openly and build strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Determination to Deliver - we strive to do the right thing, consistently and with purpose.

title: Inviting Senior Editors of EI Compendex Journals
description:
We are a seasoned academic service team dedicated to advancing international scholarly exchange and collaboration. To better support researchers worldwide in disseminating their work, we are now seeking experienced professionals like you—with a background as an editor or special issue organizer for EI Compendex-indexed journals —to join our expert team and contribute to elevating the quality and impact of academic papers.


We Are Looking For Candidates with the Following Profile:

  • A strong academic research background and a respected reputation in your field.
  • Must possess one of the following senior-level experiences:
  • Must currently be organizing and guest-editing a Special Issue for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.
  • Must currently be serving as an editor, associate editor, or editorial board member for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.


Your Role Will Include (Clear Academic Support Services):

  • Academic Review & Deep Polishing: Evaluate manuscripts for scientific rigor, logic, and originality, while refining academic expression, flow, and terminology to meet international publication standards.
  • Professional Translation & Grammar Polishing: Accurately translate Chinese research papers into natural, fluent academic English, ensuring correctness in grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.
  • Figure Optimization: Ensure all figures, charts, and images in the manuscript comply with the technical requirements of target journals, including but not limited to: format, layout, resolution (DPI), color mode, and file size.
  • Cover Letter Drafting: Assist authors in concisely summarizing the manuscript’s core strengths, innovations, and academic value in a compelling cover letter , enhancing its initial impression on journal editors.
  • Submission Assistance: Based on the article’s specific content, academic quality, and research field, recommend suitable journals indexed in the EI Compendex database for the author’s reference and selection.


Our Commitment and Emphasis (Core Compliance):

  • Full Compliance: All services we provide are strictly for “academic support” and absolutely do not involve any form of ghostwriting, data fabrication, or plagiarism . Your work will focus solely on improving the quality of the author’s original manuscript, with all final decisions remaining with the author.
  • No Acceptance Guarantee: We do not and cannot guarantee that any manuscript will be accepted. The final decision on publication rests entirely with the journal’s editors and peer-review process. Submission assistance is solely a recommendation based on content and does not imply any outcome.
  • Respect for Academic Integrity: We strictly adhere to publishing ethics standards (e.g., COPE guidelines). Our services are designed to help authors overcome language, presentation, and technical barriers, not to replace their core research work.


By Joining Us, You Will Receive:

  • Competitive remuneration and flexible working hours that fully respect your academic schedule.
  • Opportunities to engage with cutting-edge research and exchange ideas with outstanding global scholars.
  • The professional satisfaction of contributing to clearer, more standardized, and influential scientific communication.

If our mission resonates with you, and you wish to leverage your senior experience to help more scholars share their work globally, we sincerely invite you to get in touch.


We look forward to partnering with you in upholding the beacon of academic excellence!

Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Test Engineer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only ), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the Role:

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and API-based applications. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to design and execute test strategies that support modern engineering practices and high-quality software delivery.

This role is ideal for someone with strong automation expertise, a deep understanding of quality engineering, and the ability to collaborate effectively in distributed Agile teams.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web applications using Selenium WebDriver .
  • Create and maintain automated tests for RESTful APIs, including validation of headers, payloads, and data structures.
  • Develop and support test frameworks using Java , Cucumber , and Maven .
  • Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines within Jenkins , integrating version control and build tools.
  • Validate data integrity through SQL queries and support backend testing.
  • Troubleshoot issues by analyzing logs, debugging test failures, and collaborating closely with development teams.
  • Work with JIRA for requirement management and defect tracking, and Confluence for documentation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, collaborate across global teams, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience with Selenium , including locators, waits, and driver configuration.
  • Strong experience in REST API testing, including JSON/XML validation, HTTP verbs, Postman, and Swagger.
  • Good experience with Java , including control structures, exception handling, and database queries.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, including DML, joins, and basic schema definitions.
  • Good experience with Jenkins , including job configuration and integrating Git/SVN and Maven.
  • Hands-on experience with Cucumber , including writing feature files and step definitions.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work with distributed teams.
  • Strong understanding of software testing best practices, debugging techniques, and problem-solving.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Allure reporting.
  • Background in test strategy definition or QA process improvements.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices or willingness to learn.
  • Experience in highly collaborative, fast-paced environments.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Client

Our client is a global technology company specialized in large-scale cloud infrastructure, automation of distributed systems, and deep integration between hardware and software.

The engineering environment is highly technical, fast-paced, and built around autonomy, ownership, and solving complex infrastructure challenges at global scale.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer with a strong software engineering background and solid experience in automating complex infrastructure environments.

This is a high-impact, product-focused role , responsible for building tools, automation layers, APIs, and workflows that will be directly consumed by the company’s customers — not only internal teams.

This is not a traditional DevOps/Platform position focused on provisioning resources internally.

Here, you will be designing and engineering infrastructure automation as product , interacting with hardware, clusters, and low-level systems that power a global cloud offering.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop tools, automations, APIs, and infrastructure workflows used directly by end customers.
  • Build automation layers that interact with physical hardware and low-level components (state management, provisioning logic, control sequences, etc.).
  • Create and maintain internal backends and integrations linking services, infrastructure, and the core platform.
  • Leverage programming languages — especially Python — to design robust and scalable automation solutions.
  • Work on the automation behind global infrastructure and distributed clusters.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement within the platform and proactively propose solutions.


Technical Requirements

  • Senior-level experience in software development , especially with Python.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation and distributed environments.
  • Experience working with hardware , data centers, bare-metal environments, or infrastructure-heavy companies.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, internal workflows, provisioning automation, and backend integrations.
  • Ability to work in low-level contexts involving hardware components and state management.
  • Proven experience building solutions from scratch , not only executing predefined tasks.


Cultural & Behavioral Profile

  • High autonomy: must be able to discover opportunities, define approaches, and drive solutions independently.
  • Seniority and maturity to operate within a team of highly experienced engineers.
  • Hands-on, proactive mindset, with strong ownership and problem-solving orientation.
  • Experience in fast-paced environments (startups or mixed small/large company backgrounds).
  • Curiosity and flexibility to learn new technologies and navigate cross-disciplinary areas.


English Requirement

  • Advanced English is mandatory , as the leadership and part of the engineering team are international.


What Will Not Fit

  • Junior or mid-level professionals.
  • Candidates who only worked in slow, highly structured corporate environments.
  • Profiles focused solely on execution or maintenance (not creation).
  • Professionals who depend heavily on direction and lack technical autonomy.


Contract Model

  • PJ / Contractor (LLC) — engagement through independent contractor arrangement.
  • The candidate must be legally able to invoice through a company (LLC or equivalent).


Work Model

  • Remote (remote-friendly).
  • The company has no restrictions regarding location, as long as the candidate meets performance expectations and availability for team collaboration.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on the core product , not just internal tooling.
  • Unique combination of software + hardware + global infrastructure engineering .
  • High autonomy and opportunity to design new components from scratch.
  • Collaboration with a senior, highly technical engineering team.

  • Proficiency with modern testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Postman, Jest).
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-based testing (Storybook or similar).
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively within agile teams.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and quality advocacy.


Nice to Have

  • Experience testing Drupal APIs and integrations with headless front-ends.

  • Exposure to visual regression testing tools like Percy or Chromatic.

What You’ll Get

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:

  • An unstoppable internal drive

  • SaaS experience is a plus 


Our Culture


We are a nimble, fast-growing startup with a fully remote work environment. We have different backgrounds and life experiences that create a highly motivated, empowered and productive team. 


We are all committed to excellent work, whether it be one task or a big project - we believe in sticking things out until they are finished, and in communicating as quickly and effectively as possible when things get in the way of completing promised work. We are committed to improving the lives of our customers through our platform and our genuine care for them.

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:

· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;

· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;

· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;

· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;

· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;

· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;

· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);

· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade

· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil

· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios

· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade

· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum

Minimum Education:

· Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0

· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

· English (plus)

title: Analista financeiro
description:
️ Sobre a vaga

A Baggio e Carvalho Engenharia é uma empresa de médio porte, especializada em gestão e execução de obras comerciais e residenciais desde 1986. A empresa vem em um ritmo de crescimento interessante nos últimos anos e está buscando pessoas para somar e crescer com ela.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Administrativo de Obra (Financeiro) para atuar em nossa obra, um projeto com alto volume de controle e exigência de detalhamento junto ao cliente. Procuramos alguém dinâmico(a), organizado(a) e com atenção aos detalhes, contribuindo para a eficiência dos processos administrativos e financeiros da obra.


Principais atividades da função:

Controlar e manter atualizado o caixinha da obra e os reembolsos, garantindo que não haja virada de mês sem fechamento;

Receber, conferir e lançar todas as notas fiscais da obra (APs, PPCs e PCTs) no Sienge, observando dados de faturamento, retenções e prazos de pagamento;

Verificar se as retenções de impostos (PCC, IR, INSS) estão de acordo com o ensinado e devolver ao fornecedor quando houver divergências;

Verificar o CNAE na nota fiscal do fornecedor, assegurando que esteja compatível com o serviço prestado;

Conferir o endereço da obra nas notas fiscais, garantindo que esteja conforme o solicitado pelo cliente;

Cobrar as apropriações da engenharia para lançamento das APs e controle financeiro;

Emitir e conferir relatórios de pedidos de compra em aberto, boletins de medição e saldos de contratos, cobrando notas fiscais correspondentes;

Controlar adiantamentos de fornecedores, solicitando NFs referentes a entregas e serviços;

Enviar contratos para assinatura digital e realizar liberação no Sienge após conferência dos documentos;

Lançar aditivos positivos e negativos conforme solicitação da engenharia;

Emitir e conferir relatório “Administração de Obras”, montar RP e enviar ao financeiro corporativo com as notas e documentos exigidos pelo cliente;

Acompanhar relatórios de distorção por apropriação e de saldos de credores, cobrando notas fiscais de fornecedores já pagos por adiantamento;

Enviar relatório diário de notas lançadas e faturadas contra a Baggio;

Acompanhar e garantir o envio das CNDs mensais e documentação de terceiros;

No encerramento da obra, realizar o fechamento financeiro completo, assegurando que não existam saldos, pendências ou notas a lançar/pagar;

Apoiar demandas administrativas e financeiras do gestor de obra e da equipe de engenharia.


Pré-requisitos:

Formação completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas afins;

Experiência anterior em rotinas administrativas e financeiras de obra;

Excel intermediário ou avançado;

Perfil proativo, sistemático e detalhista, com boa capacidade de organização;

Facilidade de comunicação e comprometimento com prazos e qualidade das entregas.


Desejável:

Conhecimento em Sienge;

Experiência em obras com múltiplos CNPJs e contratos diferenciados;

Conhecimento em processos de medição e apropriação de custos;

Vivência em relacionamento direto com clientes corporativos e processos de auditoria financeira.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Senior Software QA Engineer


Location: Brazil Fully Remote

Reports To: Head of QA/ Engineering Manager

Setup: Consultancy/PJ

Must Have: English Resume and Professional level of English Communication Skills


About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Sr QA Engineer with strong experience in both automated and manual testing. This role is critical to ensuring our products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and user experience. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to design and execute test plans, build automated test suites, and champion quality across the entire software development lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Test Planning & Execution
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and potential risks.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases covering functional, regression, integration, and performance scenarios.
  • Perform manual testing for exploratory, usability, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Test Automation
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, and regression).
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality feedback.
  • Monitor and maintain test results, ensuring failures are triaged quickly.
  • Defect Tracking & Reporting
  • Log, prioritize, and track defects using issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Azure Linear).
  • Partner with developers to reproduce, debug, and verify fixes.
  • Provide clear reporting on test coverage, pass/fail rates, and quality trends.
  • Quality Advocacy
  • Participate in design reviews, backlog grooming, and sprint planning to identify potential issues early.
  • Suggest process improvements to enhance efficiency and prevent defects.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a QA Engineer, Software Tester, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in writing automated tests using frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar .
  • Experience testing APIs using tools like Postman , REST Assured, or similar.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI).
  • Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


Why Join Us

  • Work with a collaborative, high-performing engineering team that values quality at every step.
  • Opportunity to shape and improve our test automation strategy and quality processes.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and opportunities for career growth.

description:

title: Quality Control Lead
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a structured, strict, and technically-minded Head of Quality Assurance who will build and lead one of the most critical operational units in the company.

Scope of responsibility:

  • Management of a team of 30+ remote assistants
  • Quality control of 5,000+ job applications/month (scaling to 10,000+)
  • Direct reporting to the CEO


Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • 30 assistants submit job applications on behalf of clients
  • Quality is inconsistent—there is no systematic control
  • Many manual review processes → we need automation
  • No structured onboarding for new assistants
  • No clear KPIs or performance-based motivation


What must be built:

Audit the current team

Hire additional assistants

Build a full Quality Assurance system from scratch

Automate quality checks in collaboration with engineering

Implement onboarding, training, and control processes


Key Responsibilities

Build a Quality Assurance system (30%)

First 2 weeks:

  • Audit current assistants
  • Evaluate work quality (accuracy, speed, compliance)
  • Decide who stays, who leaves
  • Create quality criteria and checklists

Ongoing:

  • Implement regular quality audits and spot-checks
  • Establish KPIs (quality, speed, customer satisfaction)
  • Track quality metrics per assistant
  • Identify repeating errors and remove root causes
  • Review difficult cases with the team

Hiring & Onboarding (25%)

Hiring:

  • Design the hiring funnel (screening → test task → interview)
  • Hire new assistants within first 1–2 months
  • Maintain a candidate pipeline (no current churn, but may appear)

Onboarding & training:

  • Build a structured onboarding program (1–2 weeks)
  • Teach systems, standards, and workflows
  • Certify assistants before they start working with clients
  • Create training materials, videos, guides

Automation & Technology (20%)

Work with engineering team:

  • Identify which checks can be automated
  • Create clear requirements and tasks for developers
  • Test and launch automation tools
  • Utilize AI and scripts for monitoring

Automation examples:

  • Automatic validation of application fields
  • Duplicate application detection
  • Performance dashboards and speed tracking
  • Quality alert system
  • Real-time monitoring tools

Team Management (15%)

  • Workload distribution among assistants
  • KPI tracking and performance reviews
  • Escalation handling and issue resolution
  • Motivation and team culture development

People development:

  • Selective 1:1s
  • Coaching low performers
  • Promote top performers into team leads
  • Create internal career paths

Continuous improvement (10%)

  • Identify bottlenecks and improve processes
  • Implement best practices and standardization
  • Maintain operations documentation
  • Work with client complaints, root cause elimination

Requirements

Must-Have:

2+ years managing operational teams

  • Experience managing 20+ employees
  • Built processes from scratch
  • Preferably BPO/outsourcing/call center/EdTech

Strong systems thinking and discipline

  • SOPs, checklists, regulations, compliance
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Ability to make difficult decisions (terminations, corrective action)

Technical competency

  • Understanding of automation & quality monitoring
  • Ability to write clear requirements for developers
  • Experience with CRM, monitoring dashboards, etc.
  • Nice-to-have: SQL basics, API logic, scripting

Analytical approach

  • Metrics: quality %, speed, productivity, error rate
  • KPI systems and reporting
  • Data-driven decision-making

Experience in hiring & onboarding


Strong Plus:

BPO/outsourcing experience (data entry, support, back office)

Quality automation experience

Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen knowledge

Experience scaling teams from 10 → 50+

QA/Quality Management certifications

Experience with distributed remote teams

A Bram Offshore Transportes Marítimos é uma empresa do Grupo Edison Chouest Offshore e especializada no transporte marítimo de apoio à indústria de petróleo e gás no Brasil. Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70 embarcações altamente especializadas, de última geração.


Quer se juntar a nós e fazer parte do time Offshore?
